Anika (Docs): Quick heads-up: running a smoke pass over examples and found a cluster of v1 -> v2 breakages. Some sample apps fail with TypeError when people copy snippets.

Sam (SDK): Can you paste the smallest repro? I'll prioritize a compatibility shim if it's simple.

Anika (Docs): Minimal repro: JS example showing `client.generate({ model: 'rw-large', prompt })` — v2 SDK surfaces `client.text.create({ model_id: 'rw-large@v2', input: prompt })`. Users see `client.generate is not a function` or wrong param shape.

Sam (SDK): Ok, plan: add a lightweight shim that accepts `generate()` and `model` but maps to `text.create()` + `model_id`. It will log a one-line deprecation at process start: "Deprecated: passing `model`/`generate()` — migrate to v2 API by 2026-06-01." I'll open SDK PR #4270. Also add env `REDWOOD_DEPREC_WARN=0` to silence logs for Private installs.

Jorge (Platform): Good. Ensure the shim only emits local process warnings, not telemetry. Private/Dedicated customers should see no hosted-specific noise. We'll document the env opt-out in the private upgrade notes.

Riley (PM): Timeline suggestion: ship shim early next week, docs banner + migration page the same week, hard removal 2026-06-01. Marketing and Support want two weeks heads-up before the banner.

Anika (Docs): I'll draft a migration page and a short "Quick patch" snippet we can surface at the top of legacy pages. Draft redirect rules for site host (Netlify-style) to keep links alive until removal:

```
# static/_redirects
/legacy/models  /v2/reference/models   302
/legacy/generate /v2/reference/text   302
```

Please sanity-check.

Maya (Eng-ML): One streaming gotcha: v1 emitted SSE events with `event: chunk`; v2 uses `event: delta` for incremental outputs. Docs should show a tiny consumer that handles both names to avoid regressions for streaming users.

Anika (Docs): I'll add a streaming compatibility snippet showing a simple switch on the event field and a brief note about slight framing differences in multi-line tokens.

Sam (SDK): PR #4270 will include TypeScript snippet fixes across examples and the deprecation shim. I can target merge by Tue AM. I'll tag the docs PR after merge so you can update live snippets.

Anika (Docs): I opened docs PR #3012 with the migration page draft and a search/replace checklist. It includes an eval snippet that compares a v1 call to its v2 equivalent. Need an eng reviewer for tokenization notes.

Maya (Eng-ML): I'll review the eval and streaming fragments today. Also suggest adding a small test note: "re-run evals with the same seed/prompt set to check for regressions." Put that in the checklist.

Riley (PM): Owners and next steps: Sam 1 SDK PR #4270 (shim + snippets), Anika 1 docs PR #3012 (migration guide + redirects), Jorge 1 private upgrade changelog and env guidance, Maya 1 technical review of eval + streaming. Target merge by Wed 2026-03-11; canary the banner Thu.

Sam (SDK): Aiming for Tue merge. I'll make the shim silent by default in Dedicated/Private based on deployment config and expose `REDWOOD_DEPREC_WARN` as the override.

Jorge (Platform): After merges, I'll add a nightly smoke job that runs the top 10 docs snippets against staging to detect future breakage. Also add a note in the Private release notes so self-hosted operators can patch their docs.

Support Bot: support-ticket #7921 created and linked to this thread 1 customer reported the generate() sample failing.

Anika (Docs): Draft checklist for the migration page (top-of-page bullets):
- Swap `model` -> `model_id` and use `client.text.create` (JS/TS/Python examples).
- Update streaming consumers to accept `event: delta` and fallback to `event: chunk`.
- Add redirects for legacy endpoints to v2 reference pages.
- Private/Dedicated customers: consult private upgrade notes and set `REDWOOD_DEPREC_WARN=0` if desired.
- Re-run evals with a fixed prompt set to verify parity.

Maya (Eng-ML): +1. Also add a short note about slight latency differences when using the shim vs native v2 call (shim has trivial overhead). Users running tight latency SLOs should migrate sooner.

Anika (Docs): Will incorporate and push update to PR #3012 after SDK merges. If anything blocks, fallback is to insert a bold top-of-page notice on legacy endpoints pointing to `/v2/migration`.

Sam (SDK): Leaving action items in PR description and will ping once merged. 

Riley (PM): Thanks folks. After merges, I'll work with Marketing on banner language and with Support on canned replies. Close the loop here once PRs land and nightly smoke tests run a green pass.

Anika (Docs): Thanks all 1 will update docs changelog and queue the canary. :rocket:
